        sharesHousehold:

          description: >-

          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:

    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's title followed by a space and the last name, or just the last
                name when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'DR Franklin'
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'Franklin, George'
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of first and last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'G.F.'
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: a leading '+' and country
                code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                Assigned customer code formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>': the upper-cased first three
                letters of the last name, a dash, then a global 4-digit zero-padded sequence.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'SMI-0007'
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                Stable identifier shared by every owner in the same household (same last name
                and address, compared case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace).
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners sharing this owner's first and last name
                (compared case-insensitively) at the time this owner was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 1
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year that contains the business-day-adjusted registration date,
                formatted 'FY<YY>'. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and is named by its
                starting calendar year, so a date on or after 1 July belongs to that year.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'FY26'
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                Assigned membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where YY is the
                last two digits of the registration date's fiscal year.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                Total membership points, starting at 0: plus 2 when an email address is
                present, plus 1 when the owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0), plus 2
                for a household of three or more members, and plus 3 for tenure over 365 days.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 3
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                Numeric membership level from 1 to 4, derived from membershipPoints:
                1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3 points), 3 (4-5 points), 4 (6 or more points).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              readOnly: true
              example: 2
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region derived from the owner's city via a fixed city-to-region
                table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' otherwise.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'NSW'
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone derived from the owner's locality/region via a fixed
                region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane).
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email address is
                present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'EMAIL'
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band derived from their birth date, measured against the
                registration date: 'MINOR' (under 18), 'ADULT' (18-64) or 'SENIOR' (65+).
                Absent when no birth date was supplied.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'ADULT'
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners have already been registered today at the time
                this owner was created, signalling an unusually high daily signup volume.
              type: boolean
              default: false
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                Derived duplicate-detection key formatted 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId':
                the telephone reduced to its digits, the lower-cased email (empty when absent), and
                the household id. Two owners are the same registration only when these keys match.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|A1B2C3D4E5F6'
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                The single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the decimal digits of the
                customer code.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              readOnly: true
              example: 7
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, although not a hard duplicate, shares an existing owner's
                last name and postcode while having a different telephone.
              type: boolean
              default: false
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner possibly duplicates (same last name and
                postcode, different telephone), or absent when there is no such match.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              readOnly: true
              example: 7
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                True when the owner has been soft-deleted via DELETE /api/owners/{id}.
                The record is retained and still readable; a newly created owner is false.
              type: boolean
              default: false
              readOnly: true
              example: false
          required:
            - pets

openapi: 3.0.1
info:
  title: Spring PetClinic
  description: Spring PetClinic Sample Application.
  license:
    name: Apache 2.0
    url: https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
  version: '1.0'
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api
tags:
  - name: oops
    description: Endpoint which always returns an error.
  - name: owners
    description: Endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: owner-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: users
    description: Endpoints related to users.
  - name: pets
    description: Endpoints related to pets.
  - name: pet-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pets.
  - name: vets
    description: Endpoints related to vets.
  - name: visits
    description: Endpoints related to vet visits.
  - name: pettypes
    description: Endpoints related to pet types.
  - name: specialties
    description: Endpoints related to vet specialties.
paths:
  /oops:
    get:
      tags:
        - oops
      operationId: failingRequest
      summary: Always fails
      description: Produces sample error response.
      responses:
        200:
          description: Never returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            text/plain:
              schema:
                type: string
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners:
    post:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: addOwner
      summary: Adds a pet owner
      description: Records the details of a new pet owner.
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        201:
          description: The pet owner was successfully added.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: listOwners
      summary: Lists pet owners
      description: Returns an array of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /v2/owners:
    get:
      tags:
        - owner-v2
      operationId: listOwnersPage
      summary: Lists pet owners with pagination
      description: Returns a page of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
        - name: page
          in: query
          description: Zero-based page index.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            default: 0
            example: 0
        - name: size
          in: query
          description: Number of items per page.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 100
            default: 20
            example: 5
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner page found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerPage'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            Etag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners/{ownerId}:
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: getOwner
      summary: Get a pet owner by ID
      description: Returns the pet owner or a 404 error.
      parameters:
        - name: ownerId
          in: path
          description: The ID of the pet owner.
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            example: 1
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        404:
          description: Owner not found.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    put:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: updateOwner
      summary: Update a pet owner's details
      description: Updates the pet owner record with the specified details.
      parameters:
        - name: ownerId
          in: path
          description: The ID of the pet owner.
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            example: 1
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner details to use for the update.
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        200:
          description: Update successful.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        404:
          description: Owner not found.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'

    delete:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: deleteOwner
      summary: Delete an owner by ID
      description: Returns the owner or a 404 error.
      parameters:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            Optional honorific for the owner (one of MR, MRS, MS, DR). When present it is
            prefixed to the last name to form the 'salutation'.
          type: string
          pattern: '^(MR|MRS|MS|DR)$'
          example: DR
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The primary postal address line of the pet owner (structured form). Preferred
            over the flat 'address' when present. Normalized like 'address'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '10 King St'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional secondary postal address line (structured form). Normalized and
            appended to 'addressLine1', separated by a single space, in the composed 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat input for backward
            compatibility; on output it is the composed, normalized structured address
            when structured fields are supplied.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be valid for the
            city's region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no
            known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^\d{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored and returned in E.164 form:
            a leading '+' and country code are kept when present, otherwise '+61' is
            assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits;
            spaces, dashes and brackets are ignored. Rejected unless 8 to 15 digits
            remain after the '+'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: "^[-+()\\d ]+$"
          example: '0412 345 678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The owner's date of birth. Optional. When present, the owner's 'ageBand'
            is derived from it, measured against the registration date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted. Must not be later than the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
          x-field-extra-annotation: '@jakarta.validation.constraints.PastOrPresent'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Request-only flag. When true, allows creating an owner who shares another
            owner's last name and address instead of rejecting it as a household duplicate.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's title followed by a space and the last name, or just the last
                name when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'DR Franklin'
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'Franklin, George'
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of first and last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'G.F.'
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: a leading '+' and country
                code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                Assigned customer code formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>': the upper-cased first three
                letters of the last name, a dash, then a global 4-digit zero-padded sequence.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'SMI-0007'
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                Stable identifier shared by every owner in the same household (same last name
                and address, compared case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace).
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners sharing this owner's first and last name
                (compared case-insensitively) at the time this owner was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 1
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year that contains the business-day-adjusted registration date,
                formatted 'FY<YY>'. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and is named by its
                starting calendar year, so a date on or after 1 July belongs to that year.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'FY26'
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                Assigned membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where YY is the
                last two digits of the registration date's fiscal year.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                Total membership points, starting at 0: plus 2 when an email address is
                present, plus 1 when the owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0), plus 2
                for a household of three or more members, and plus 3 for tenure over 365 days.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 3
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                Numeric membership level from 1 to 4, derived from membershipPoints:
                1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3 points), 3 (4-5 points), 4 (6 or more points).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              readOnly: true
              example: 2
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region derived from the owner's city via a fixed city-to-region
                table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' otherwise.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'NSW'
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone derived from the owner's locality/region via a fixed
                region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane).
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email address is
                present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'EMAIL'
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band derived from their birth date, measured against the
                registration date: 'MINOR' (under 18), 'ADULT' (18-64) or 'SENIOR' (65+).
                Absent when no birth date was supplied.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'ADULT'
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners have already been registered today at the time
                this owner was created, signalling an unusually high daily signup volume.
              type: boolean
              default: false
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                Derived duplicate-detection key formatted 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId':
                the telephone reduced to its digits, the lower-cased email (empty when absent), and
                the household id. Two owners are the same registration only when these keys match.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|A1B2C3D4E5F6'
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                The single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the decimal digits of the
                customer code.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              readOnly: true
              example: 7
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, although not a hard duplicate, shares an existing owner's
                last name and postcode while having a different telephone.
              type: boolean
              default: false
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner possibly duplicates (same last name and
                postcode, different telephone), or absent when there is no such match.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              readOnly: true
              example: 7
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                True when the owner has been soft-deleted via DELETE /api/owners/{id}.
                The record is retained and still readable; a newly created owner is false.
              type: boolean
              default: false
              readOnly: true
              example: false
